provenance: Other-method results are as reported by the Life-Harness authors; these are not our reruns or necessarily the original method authors' scores.
protocol_notes: Meta-Harness, AHE and Life-Harness use six evolution rounds and the same training batches within the paper, with GPT-5.5 as evolution model. Our campaign budgets and optimizers differ.
ALIGN and AgentSquare are released final harness evaluations on ALFWorld and WebShop. ALIGN uses its released task split; AgentSquare uses the Life-Harness task selection.
Paper AgentBench uses one evaluation per task. Our released scores average three. Telecom simulator/access/auxiliary-call conditions differ.
Table 1 values and evolution-token totals are rounded; Table 10/11 values retain their published precision. Null means not reported here, never zero.

methods.label: Bare / 裸模型
methods.description_en: Frozen actor without an evolved harness.
methods.description_zh: 冻结做题模型，不添加进化后的 harness。

methods.label: ALIGN
methods.description_en: Generates an environment interface for the agent.
methods.description_zh: 为智能体生成环境交互接口。

methods.label: AgentSquare
methods.description_zh: 搜索模块化智能体架构。

methods.label: Meta-Harness
methods.description_en: Searches harness programs using previous code, scores, and traces.
methods.description_zh: 结合历史代码、分数和轨迹搜索 harness 程序。

methods.label: AHE
methods.description_en: Edits harness files and checks expected effects in evaluations.
methods.description_zh: 修改 harness 组件文件，通过评测检验改动是否产生预期效果。

methods.label: Life-Harness v3
methods.description_en: Evolves interventions across four interaction lifecycle layers.
